calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark, compute the prior-session close to current-session opening gap and take the negative three-session mean. Higher values indicate recent negative opening gaps and a contrarian long signal. The signal is aligned to next-session close-to-close returns without look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Daily admission gates pass on the 15-instrument benchmark (absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840). Positive in 2020-22 and 2023-24, weaker and below ICIR gate in 2025-26; interpret uncertainty conservatively given 13.52 average names and only 321 valid dates caused by open-data availability.
